name: Object Space Ray Tracing for Remote Volume Rendering
aliases: Ray tracing technique rendering object space samples as spheres
definition: A remote volume rendering technique that replaces the 2.5D point rendering phase of the original Zellmann et al. algorithm with an object space ray tracing phase to reduce rendering artifacts in volumetric and transparent regions.
summary: Object Space Ray Tracing for Remote Volume Rendering eliminates artifacts by transmitting compacted position and radius samples to a client that ray traces them as spheres instead of compositing fixed-size sprites.
